title: OSHA Log
oneLiner: Free online OSHA 300 log for small US employers: record each case once, get the 300 log, the auto-totaled 300A summary, 301 reports and an ITA-ready CSV
customer: US employers with 11 to 250 staff who must keep OSHA injury and illness records (construction, manufacturing, warehousing, healthcare, retail) and keep them in PDFs or spreadsheets today
revenueModel: Free log for one establishment; paid tier for several establishments, team access, multi-year history and import of old logs

paidPrice.product: LogStead OSHA recordkeeping software at USD 39 a month or USD 390 a year (14 day trial). About Rs 3,677 a month at 94.2754 INR per USD

searches.note: seodata.dev (Google Ads monthly averages, United States), read 2026-11-28. Variants like osha form 300 and osha log 300 likely share one Google group, so only the head term (8,100) is counted toward the screen. Also https://api.seodata.dev/v1/keyword?q=osha+301&country=us. The exact software terms are tiny (osha recordkeeping software 30, CPC USD 90), so buyers arrive on form terms, not software terms.

screen.freeGap: Free options are files or single slices: the official OSHA forms are PDFs and fillable spreadsheets (https://www.osha.gov/recordkeeping/forms, https://labor.arkansas.gov/wp-content/uploads/OSHA-300-fillable.pdf), and LogStead gives away a recordability checker, ITA CSV validator and an auto-totaling Excel workbook but keeps the online log, 301 reports and the ITA CSV export paid (https://log-stead.vercel.app/tools). Gap: a free online log that keeps the cases and produces 300, 300A, 301 and the ITA CSV end to end. Risk: LogStead already runs this exact free tools plus USD 39 plan, and SafetyCulture publishes an OSHA 300 log page (https://safetyculture.com/logs/osha-300-log); the free workbook may be enough for very small employers.

serp.notes: osha 300 log (WebSearch): static PDFs from dir.nv.gov (two), slh.wisc.edu, dol.ks.gov, osha.oregon.gov, labor.arkansas.gov and bls.gov fill most of the top 10, plus biotech.law.lsu.edu, safetyculture.com, docs.oracle.com and hsi.com. osha form 300 (WebSearch): PDFs from slh.wisc.edu, bls.gov, nj.gov, labor.hawaii.gov, labor.arkansas.gov (two) and dir.nv.gov, plus bamboohr.com glossary pages and osha.gov. No free tool on page one keeps the log end to end. Firecrawl search was out of credits, so only one source was read; count is the WebSearch count.

evidence.claim: LogStead sells an online OSHA 300 log with auto-totaled 300A and an ITA-ready CSV at USD 39 a month or USD 390 a year, with Starter, Professional and Business plans.
HB Next sells OSHA 300 Cloud at USD 99.00 per year per establishment: OSHA 300 log and 300A summary generated automatically, 301s from any device, and 300A submission to the OSHA ITA by CSV or API.

SiteSafety HQ is listed on Capterra from USD 99, with a Crew plan at USD 39 a month for up to 15 people at one location, and says it fills OSHA Forms 300, 301 and 300A (14 day trial; 0 reviews on the listing).
Epostrix is listed on Capterra with a Growth plan at USD 299 a month that includes OSHA 300 auto-fill and OSHA 300A document generation, inside a wider OSHA and EPA compliance suite.
IncidentLog, a QR code incident reporting tool that auto-generates OSHA 300, 300A and 301 PDFs, is listed as freemium with a subscription of up to USD 89 a month and a limited free version.

A software vendor (Veoci) asked OSHA in writing whether software-generated 300 and 300A forms are accepted; OSHA replied on 29 Apr 2025 that equivalent forms in any format, including Excel or CSV, are accepted if they carry the same information and print on request, while 300A must still be certified and posted and ITA submission is required.

killReason: No-go: case scores 20 of 35 against a bar of 24 (competitionGap 2, speedToRevenue 2). Spot checked 28 Nov 2026: Salus gives a free Excel OSHA 300 log with 300A totals (salussafety.io/us/osha/300-log), LogStead gives a free auto-totaling 300/300A workbook and ITA CSV validator (log-stead.vercel.app/tools), HB Next sells the online log at USD 99 a year per establishment (hbnext.com), and the head term osha 300 log is 8,100 a month (seodata.dev). Our free single-establishment tier gives away what most buyers need, there is no payment rail, and a new subdomain will miss the Feb 2027 peak. The paid-per-establishment pivot meets a USD 99 a year incumbent and free workbooks with no new buyer evidence, so no pivot.
